ammonia.reason: mild surface deamination by Geotrichum with pH rise 4.4 to 5.1 at surface, low urea/amino-acid deamination

animal_barnyard.reason: 3-methylbutanoic 293 ug/kg plus 4-Me/4-Et octanoic goat acids and Geotrichum deacidification

bitter.reason: limited hydrophobic peptides from low rennet 520mg chymosin/L and short ripening with starter peptidases

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium roqueforti, only low 2-heptanone 156 and 2-nonanone 393 ug/kg from lipolysis

browning.reason: low pH 4.3 and depleted lactose reduces Maillard when heated

buttery.reason: low acetoin 78-97 ug/kg from mesophilic starter citrate metabolism, no creamery diacetyl

cheesy_sweaty.reason: hexanoic 23380 plus octanoic 32958 plus butanoic 289 ug/kg from lipolysis at 5-10x threshold at 31d

creaminess.reason: high moisture 67.3% fresh plus Geotrichum proteolysis creaming under ash rind

crumbliness.reason: acid gel at pH 4.3 demineralized casein from 24h lactic coagulation gives short fracture

firmness.reason: lactic drained log with straw, chalky-firm paste despite high moisture

floral_honey.reason: phenylethanol 1007 ug/kg from phenylalanine catabolism by surface flora

fruity.reason: ethyl butanoate 146 plus ethyl hexanoate 258 plus ethyl octanoate 480 ug/kg from esterification

goaty.reason: goat-specific 4-methyloctanoic 139 plus 4-ethyloctanoic 27 ug/kg plus C6/C8/C10 above threshold

malty_nutty.reason: uncooked lactic curd with no propionibacteria or Strecker aldehyde maltol formation

melt.reason: acid demineralized low-pH curd softens but does not flow on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: Geotrichum candidum sprayed surface flora producing C8 and earthy notes

oil_off.reason: low fat ~45% FDM ~14.7% wet and acid emulsion stable, little free oil

smoky.reason: vegetable ash coating only, no smoking and no guaiacol

sour_vinegar.reason: 24h mesophilic lactic fermentation to pH 4.3 with high lactic acid

stretch.reason: no pasta-filata stretching, acid curd with no aligned casein network

sulfur_cooked.reason: uncooked curd at 17-20C, no heat-induced H2S and low methionine catabolism

sweet.reason: lactose depleted by lactic fermentation, sour pH masks sweetness

umami.reason: short >=10d ripening with low proteolysis and low glutamate release
